$comment: What the air-gapped host installs at first boot, pinned here so a change is a synth and a review, never a surprise at boot. The host cannot install packages (no route out), so Node comes from the exchange bucket's tools/ prefix where `npm run airgap:up` staged it (the gzip tarball: the base image has gzip and tar, not necessarily xz), verified against this digest before it is extracted; the released CLI's digest is the fleet's one pin in services/eu-host/pins.json. The AMI is pinned per region because a resolved-at-deploy image replaces the instance on every AL2023 refresh (a replacement is a new host, a new keypair, a re-seal).
